claims.content: To allow the System Administrator to configure permissions (Edit, Delete, View, Print) for a new User Group, with all permission settings being mandatory during creation.

goal.raw_text: To allow the System Administrator to configure permissions (Edit, Delete, View, Print) for a new User Group, with all permission settings being mandatory during creation.

claims.content: System Administrator
System Administrator is logged in to the system.
The System Administrator has the capability to create User Groups, as only the system admin can create User Groups.
The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new User Group, which requires configuring mandatory permissions (Edit, Delete, View, Print) as part of the group setup process.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new User Group, which requires configuring mandatory permissions (Edit, Delete, View, Print) as part of the group setup process.

claims.content: The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new User Group.

The system requires the administrator to configure mandatory permission settings for the User Group: Edit (Allowed / Not Allowed), Delete (Allowed / Not Allowed), View (Allowed / Not Allowed), and Print (Allowed / Not Allowed).
The system validates that all permission fields are provided, as they are mandatory while creating a new User Group.
The system saves the User Group configuration only if all mandatory permission settings are correctly entered.
The system does not allow the user to create a User Group with an existing name.
If any mandatory permission field (Edit, Delete, View, Print) is left unconfigured during User Group creation, the system prevents saving the configuration.
A new User Group is created with configured permissions (Edit, Delete, View, Print) set to either 'Allowed' or 'Not Allowed'.
The system enforces that all permission fields (Edit, Delete, View, Print) are mandatory during User Group creation.
Individual users can be created under the newly configured User Group.
The system prevents creation of a User Group with an existing name.
User Group information including Group Code and Group Name is stored as part of the masters data.
